$comment: Windows quality-gate known-failure roster — the ONLY sanctioned way for a spec file to stay red on the CI (Windows) lane without failing it.

Admission rules (TC-CI-GREEN §2, D23): (1) the file fails on a pristine reference tree too (upstream/environment face, evidenced), or (2) the failure is a REGISTERED Go semantic deviation (TD-2/TD-3).
Everything else must stay red: this roster is never a red-to-green switch, and `pnpm run test:ci` refuses to load a malformed roster.
Entries name exact spec files (no globs) so an entry cannot mask sibling files or later-added examples.

lane=github-windows-ci: red on the hosted Windows runner and locally. lane=workstation: reproduces only in this development machine's shell environment and stays covered on the hosted runner (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true), so the hosted gate loses no coverage from those entries.
Loaded and validated by scripts/ci-windows-known-failures.ts (shape, existence, lane, reason, evidence, no duplicate path, no `..` traversal); pinned by scripts/ci-workflow.spec.ts.
